eventDetail.scope: NIGERCON 2026 brings together researchers, industry practitioners, policymakers, and technology leaders to explore the convergence of emerging technologies driving digital transformation across critical sectors in Nigeria and Africa. The conference focuses on practical applications of AI, telecommunications, fintech, healthcare technology, smart infrastructure, and sustainable innovations that address unique African challenges while contributing to global knowledge. Technical sessions will cover advances in generative AI, 5G/6G networks, blockchain applications, biometric systems, agricultural technology, pharmaceutical supply chains, manufacturing automation, digital financial services, and smart city solutions. The conference emphasizes research-to-market pathways, fostering collaboration between academia, industry, and government to build inclusive innovation ecosystems that drive economic resilience and societal transformation across Africa
